_comment: Recorded output of the scripts/tune-lib.ts harness (§7 band table via runBatch and the
§7.1 policy matrix via runPolicyMatrix), at bandGames/matrixGames games and the base
seeds below. tests/tuning-regression.test.ts re-runs the harness at these exact settings
and asserts each measured value stays within tests/tuning-regression.test.ts's tolerance
of the number recorded here -- a drift guard for CI, not the tuning authority.
The authority is `npm run tune` at 10,000 games on two seeds (see scripts/README.md).
That run stays manual and needs a human to read the table.
Regenerate this file ONLY deliberately, right after an intentional retune that has
already been confirmed against the 10,000-game/two-seed run -- never to make a failing
and the matching `npx vite-node -e "..."` (or a scratch script) calling
runPolicyMatrix(3000, 20260401 + 1, false) the way tests/tuning-regression.test.ts does,
then copy the printed/measured numbers in here field for field. Never hand-edit or
round a number to make a failing test pass -- every value below came out of one
recorded run of the harness, nothing typed by hand.
recordedFrom: scripts/tune-lib.ts runBatch/runPolicyMatrix, 2026-09-16, engine as tuned on claude/sleepy-galileo-8cmx5k
